beforeReload.text: There are nights when a sock disappears. On this night, Reader Check found where socks go. Past three clouds and a yawning star, Reader Check arrived at the whispering forest, where trees that kept the moonlight in their pockets. The air went whoosh and smelled faintly of warm biscuits. Ping! A star fell into a pocket and pretended it belonged there. The staircase landed in the whispering forest, where trees that kept the moonlight in their pockets. Honestly, it was a bit odd.

beforeReload.text: a moss-green hedgehog was trying to fix a lantern made of a hollow acorn with a spoon. "Need a hand?" asked Reader Check. Then the whole place hiccupped. a lantern made of a hollow acorn spun round twice and stopped, upside down. A creeeeak came from somewhere behind a very innocent-looking door. Reader Check nearly gave up, then tried a completely silly idea. That is kindness with a hat on. Ting-ting-ting went the bells, entirely out of tune but very pleased.

beforeReload.text: "We can do it together," said Reader Check. kindness, it seems, works faster in pairs. "Well," said a moss-green hedgehog, "that was the best sort of muddle." Bum-ti-tum went a small drum. Ping! A star fell into a pocket and pretended it belonged there. Ting! The lost thing was found, and the found thing was shared. It took three tries and one deep breath. kindness is a small thing that grows — and Reader Check understood it.

beforeReload.text: the whispering forest was having a very busy evening: trees that kept the moonlight in their pockets. A creeeeak came from somewhere behind a very innocent-looking door. Instead of grumbling, Reader Check asked a question first. That turned out to be kindness. Everything unfolded at once, including a sleepy troll with cold feet, who apologised and handed back the moonlight. The air went whoosh and smelled faintly of warm biscuits.
